releases.body:
Better Trove Tools now runs on a native Rust backend in a Tauri window. Same app and UI, with faster codexes (each builds in under a second) and update scans (under 2 s, down from 12-17 s).

- New: Linux AppImage and deb downloads, and the NixOS flake is back.
- Security: Capacitor 7.6.9 for the Android app, plus patched xmldom and brace-expansion.

Updating from 2026.10.06 or earlier moves the app to Program Files\Better Trove Tools: start it once from the Start menu after the update. Settings, caches and mod configs carry over.

releases.name: 2026.10.07a
releases.body: Alpha of the Rust/Tauri rewrite: the backend is now Rust (btt-core) in a Tauri window, with the same UI. Windows MSI plus, for the first time, a Linux AppImage and deb.

### Mod Manager

- New **Steam** tab when a Steam copy of Trove is selected: browse Trove's Steam Workshop, search and sort it, and subscribe from the app. Steam needs to be running to subscribe.

### Mod Manager

- Mods that Trove switched off itself now show as **Disabled by Trove**. Trove does this when you turn a mod off in game, and when mods conflict (it keeps one and disables the rest). Before, these mods looked enabled here but didn't load in game.
- Click **Disabled by Trove** to re-enable a mod. If it conflicts with mods that are on, you'll see which ones get turned off so Trove doesn't disable it again at the next launch.
- New **Disabled by Trove** filter in the status dropdown.
- Turning a Steam Workshop mod off no longer renames Steam's file. It's switched off in Trove's settings instead.
- The list updates on its own when Trove changes which mods are disabled.
- Applying a profile, installing a modpack, or importing a .tpack re-enables any of its mods that Trove had switched off.

### Mod Manager

- The Trovesaurus tab hides mods we've blocked, including copies of mods taken down from the Mods Hub. Blocked mods can't be installed from the tab, aren't offered as updates, and lose their Trovesaurus link in My Mods.

commit.message:
Make the update check work in the desktop app

The Kiwi API's CORS allowlist covers the old http://localhost page origin but not Tauri's http://tauri.localhost, so update checks, the About page's changelog and supporters, and feedback were blocked in the page. The bridge now provides BTT_Kiwi, which sends those requests through a new kiwi_request backend command (GET/POST to the API root only).
Allow the notification plugin's page script (fixes an ACL error on Linux)

Merge pull request #30 from AallynReed/fix/linux-deep-link

Register btt:// links on Linux

Pin rust-ini to 0.21.1 so tauri-plugin-deep-link builds on Linux

rust-ini 0.21.2 added ParseOption fields that tauri-plugin-deep-link 2.6.2 doesn't set.

Register btt:// links on Linux so Discord sign-in completes

Fixes #28. The deep-link plugin adds the x-scheme-handler/btt MimeType to the .deb's desktop entry and registers the scheme at launch for AppImage, Nix and source runs; single-instance forwards the link to the running window, where handle_deep_link finishes sign-in.

Don't print the Steam persona name in the Workshop session test

Clears CodeQL's cleartext-logging alert; the ignored test only needs the item count.

Merge pull request #29 from AallynReed/tauri-port

Rewrite the backend in Rust on Tauri
Nix: parse zero-padded version parts in base 10

Update Capacitor to 7.6.9 and patch xmldom and brace-expansion

Clears the 17 Dependabot alerts: the Capacitor Android proxy-path advisory (critical) and the xmldom and brace-expansion advisories pulled in through @capacitor/cli. npm audit reports 0 vulnerabilities.

Drop the parity scripts; translation tools run on any Python 3

tools/parity/*.py drove the deleted Python backend, and their output is already committed as test fixtures (the scripts stay in history). The i18n tools and sync_locale_keys.py are standard-library only, so their docs use plain python instead of the app's old venv.

Bring back the Nix flake for the Rust/Tauri app; refresh the README

The flake builds the app from source with rustPlatform and cargo-tauri.hook (version from metadata.json, WebKitGTK, tray and GStreamer wired in), and a CI job runs nix build. The README covers the Rust backend, the speedups, the NixOS install again, and the one-time relaunch after updating from the Python builds.
Recognise alpha builds: 2026.10.07a sorts below 07b and 07, shows an ALPHA pill, and joins the prerelease channel
Accept any letter suffix in the bundle version (2026.10.07a -> 2026.10.7-alpha)

Share the Python-behaviour helpers in crate::py; run the Windows-recorded parity tests only on Windows

Merges the per-module copies (str/repr/int, pathlib, OSError and JSON error text, text-mode CRLF writes) into core/src/py, keeping the variants whose output differs as separate functions. Storage and notification state now write CRLF on Windows, bodiless non-GET requests send Content-Length: 0, and the Blueprint Editor reuses the codexes language map.

Remove the Python app

Every endpoint now lives in btt-core, so backend/, utils/, models/, main.py, the cx_Freeze build, the requirements files, the Linux run scripts, the Python tests and the Nix flake (which packaged the Python app) are gone. The README documents the Tauri build, the AppImage/deb downloads and the new stack. tools/parity/*.py regenerate fixtures against the Python reference, so they need a pre-port checkout to run.
Check desktop builds on Windows and Linux in CI; snapshot the Python endpoint list

Port the Mod Manager to Rust

All 39 endpoints (My Mods, Trovesaurus, Steam Workshop catalog, Mods Hub, modpacks, profiles), the mods-folder watcher and the launch tasks. A live run against scratch copies of a real install matched Python on 124 of 124 steps. Every eel endpoint the Python backend exposed now exists in btt-core. Tests now run in a throwaway data folder, so they never touch the user's app data.

Port the Blueprint Editor to Rust

All 14 routes and save_blueprint_editor_file. Output is byte-identical to Python's for every route, all 73,988 blueprints in a real install and all 91 real mods; zlib-rs 0.5.2 reproduces CPython's zlib-ng bytes. The whole-catalog sweep drops from 838s to 78s.

Port site sign-in and the File Manager to Rust

Auth: all 32 endpoints, the DPAPI store (reads and writes the same blobs as the Python build) and the legacy launcher purge, checked against a fake API. File Manager: all 16 endpoints; trees, extractions and update baselines are byte-identical to Python's, and update scans run up to 18x faster.

Port the codexes to Rust; read Trove archives that end on a sync flush

All eight codexes build byte-identical data and manifests to Python's on a real install, 10-25x faster (0.06-0.84s each in release). The shared .tfa inflate now stops at end of input like zlib.decompressobj, since Trove never writes a final deflate block.
Keep parity fixtures byte-exact across checkouts

Port the .tmod model, Modder Tools and Steam Workshop publishing to Rust

31 endpoints. A .tmod built by Rust is byte-identical to Python's, checked by rebuilding all 91 mods of a real install; extraction trees, mod lists and ModCfgs match too. Steam Workshop loads steam_api64.dll through libloading with struct layouts asserted at compile time.

Port the home dashboard to Rust

Feeds, rotations, delve, the live event feed, event notifications and the Bilibili image proxy. Matches the Python output on golden fixtures and live against the APIs. raise_for_status now words errors like requests, and repeated query keys resolve like bottle.

Port gems and builds to Rust

All 25 endpoints match the Python output on the parity fixtures, down to int vs float and the last float bit. serde_json now parses floats exactly (float_roundtrip), as Python's json does.
Add the Tauri version overlay script CI reads
Build releases with Tauri: MSI on Windows, AppImage and deb on Linux; endpoint coverage test
Prepare btt-core for the module ports: crates, file_manager feature, porting guide

Tauri shell and Rust core foundation

The app boots in a Tauri window on a Rust backend (btt-core). The page still
calls eel.<name>(...)(): js/tauri_bridge.js carries those calls over Tauri IPC
and sends /api and /proxy fetches to a custom scheme. Ported so far: paths,
settings, locales, app metadata, self-update, notifications, install detection,
Trove.cfg and archive parsing. The feature areas are stubs.

Android: target API 36, drop Play-restricted permissions, upload stable releases to Play closed testing

Adds PRIVACY.md for the Play listing.
Mod Manager: Steam tab to browse the Trove Workshop and subscribe
